title: How to Overcome Stage Fright and Speak with Confidence
excerpt: Stage fright is completely natural. Even seasoned speakers feel butterflies. Learn how to channel that nervous energy into dynamic stage presence.
content:
# How to Overcome Stage Fright and Speak with Confidence

Did you know that the fear of public speaking (glossophobia) is often rated higher than the fear of death? If your heart races, your hands sweat, and your voice trembles before a speech, you are not alone.

The key is not to eliminate the butterflies, but to **teach them to fly in formation**.

Here are some practical tips to conquer stage fright:

### 1. Reframe Nervousness as Excitement
Physiologically, nervousness and excitement are almost identical: rapid heart rate, heightened focus, and adrenaline. Tell yourself, *"I am not nervous; I am excited to share my message."* This simple cognitive reframing shifts your mindset from defensive to enthusiastic.

### 2. Practice, Practice, Practice
Nothing builds confidence like preparation. Practice your speech out loud multiple times. Record yourself or speak in front of a mirror. Pay special attention to your opening and closing lines, so you can deliver them smoothly without notes.

### 3. Breathe Deeply
When we are anxious, we tend to take shallow breaths, which triggers a panic response. Practice diaphragmatic breathing. Take three slow, deep breaths before walking up to the stage. This activates your parasympathetic nervous system, lowering your heart rate.

### 4. Connect with the Audience
Before you start speaking, look around the room and find a few friendly, smiling faces. Speak directly to them. Remember, the audience is on your side—they want you to succeed!

### 5. Start with a Strong Visual or Question
Engage the audience immediately. Asking a question or telling a quick story shifts the spotlight from you to the topic, giving you a chance to settle in and find your rhythm.

Stage fright is a beast that can be tamed. Every time you speak, you become a little bit stronger. Keep pushing your limits!

title: Behind the Scenes of SpeechMaster 2026
excerpt: SpeechMaster is Gavel Club USJ's flagship public speaking contest. Read about the organizing committee's hard work, challenges faced, and victories celebrated.
content:
# Behind the Scenes of SpeechMaster 2026

*SpeechMaster* has grown to become one of the premier public speaking platforms in the university arena. But what goes on behind the scenes to make an event of this scale possible?

Our organizing committee spent months planning, designing, and executing the project. Here is an inside look at the journey:

### The Conceptualization
It started with a brainstorming session. We wanted a theme that represented the power of voices breaking boundaries. After hours of debate, we settled on **"Unmute Your Mind"**.

### The Logistics Hurdle
Coordinating schedules for participants from multiple faculties, booking auditoriums, hiring professional judges, and managing technical setups for audio-visual streams were complex challenges. The logistics team worked tirelessly, troubleshooting backup equipment and schedules to ensure a seamless execution.

### Marketing and Public Relations
To spread the word, our PR team designed stunning graphics, ran interactive countdowns, and published profiles of our past winners. Their efforts resulted in a record number of registrations, expanding our reach beyond Sri Jayewardenepura University.

### The Grand Finale
The grand finale was a night to remember. The atmosphere in the auditorium was electric as final contestants delivered their speeches. The culmination of hard work, sleepless nights, and collaboration resulted in one of our most successful events ever.

We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to the career guidance unit, our sponsors, judges, and most importantly, our members who made SpeechMaster 2026 a resounding success. Onward and upward!
author: Executive Committee 2025/26
